newsitem.title: USA: Olympic says still talking to suitors.
newsitem.headline: Olympic says still talking to suitors.

text.p: Olympic Financial Ltd said Wednesday it is still talking to several potential acquirers, though no definitive offer has been made.
"There are ongoing discussions with a number of suitors," Jennifer Weichert, a company spokeswoman, said in a telephone interview.

Earlier Wednesday, the auto finance company said that neither a party that had indicated an interest in the company earlier this year, nor other interested parties, had made a definitive offer. The company also said no assurance could be given that there would be an acceptable offer.
Weichert declined to comment on a timetable for a potential offer. She also would not name the potential suitors it has been in discussions with.
